snippet.title: The  Drawratos — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Targem Games announces The Drawratos, a poker game about rats that draw on cards

Targem Games development studio has announced their new indie project The Drawratos, a cooperative game for up to 4 players in which you can play poker, draw on your cards, win cheese, and try to outwit your opponents using a wide variety of tricks.

In The Drawratos, fair play is entirely up to the players. You can change your cards right in the middle of a hand, bluff, confuse your opponents, and use any means necessary to win. An entire rat family can gather around a single table, but only one player will earn the title of master of drawing!

Cards in The Drawratos become one of the main tools for trickery. Players can draw directly on them, changing the suit or rank of a card. This allows you to create new combinations, strengthen your hand, and confuse your opponents.

In each game, players must bet cheese and risk their supplies. You can lose everything in a single hand or pull off a successful scam and take your opponents’ cheese. You should be cautious about trusting other players: they might start out as an ally but try to set you up a few rounds later for another piece of cheese.

📢 Join The Drawratos playtest! Invite up to 4 friends to enjoy the fun and slightly absurd cheesy poker games. There is no content embargo, so playtest participants are free to stream, record gameplay videos, and publish reviews of the game.

You can sign up for the playtest through the game’s page on Steam. The playtest will begin shortly, and you’ll receive a notification when it starts. 

🎮 The Drawratos on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5136030/The__Drawratos/ 
More news on The Drawratos and other indie projects of the studio on our X page: https://x.com/TG_Indie
